change: JFreeChart — Pan two chart axes when only the first is inverted
deployment: Pinned non-JavaFX headless profile with JCommon and packaged resources.
assumptions: Headless JDK, ranges initialized to [0,10], independent NumberAxis receivers, equal and opposite pans.

questions.observer: Record both paired ranges and independently panned single-axis references after each pan.
questions.basis: A ten-unit axis moves by one; inversion reverses its own motion. Restoring both axes hides the historical intermediate error.

questions.observer: Observe paired and isolated axes with the inverted axis second and with neither inverted.
questions.basis: The second-axis sign agrees with its single-axis reference when the first axis did not mutate the common pan percentage.
